observations: Current page 99 visually reviewed: all three plots contain exactly seven correctly positioned black dots, with proportional horizontal spacing.
Starting data are symmetric with mean, median and mode 9. Right-tail statistics are mean 11, median 10, mode 9; left-tail statistics are mean 7, median 8, mode 9.
Independent resets correctly give mean 10 for 11→18 and mean 8 for 7→0; median and mode remain 9.
Titles, ticks and statistic labels are readable and separated. Supplied native sizes specify 10 pt labels and 8.5 pt ticks; the rendering is consistent with these sizes.
Writing areas accommodate the requested responses. No clipping, collisions or margin/footer interference are visible.

The explanation correctly allows the median and mode to remain unchanged and explicitly states that the illustrated ordering is not universal. Acceptance concerns this current rendering; exact pixel parity with earlier evidence is not claimed.
